title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 51–100 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: There is a world map on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上有一張世界地圖。

examples.en: Don't draw or write on the classroom wall.
examples.zh: 請勿在教室牆壁上塗鴉或寫字。

examples.en: They painted the bedroom wall light blue.
examples.zh: 他們把臥室的牆壁漆成了淺藍色。

examples.en: I go to bed at ten o'clock every night.
examples.zh: 我每晚十點上床睡覺。

examples.en: Make sure you make your bed before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 離開房間前請務必整理好床鋪。

examples.en: The hotel bed was very soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 飯店的床非常柔軟舒適。

examples.en: You should sleep at least seven hours a day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該至少睡七個小時。

examples.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep quickly.
examples.zh: 我太累了，很快就睡著了。

examples.en: Adequate sleep helps improve your memory and focus.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠有助於提升記憶力與專注力。

examples.en: I usually wake up at 6:30 in the morning.
examples.zh: 我通常早上六點半醒來。

examples.en: Please wake me up if my alarm doesn't ring.
examples.zh: 如果我的鬧鐘沒響，請叫醒我。

examples.en: The loud thunder woke the baby up in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲在半夜驚醒了嬰兒。

examples.en: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
examples.zh: 早安！你睡得好嗎？

examples.en: I like to do some light exercise in the morning.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在早晨做一些輕度運動。

examples.en: It was a cold and foggy morning in the mountains.
examples.zh: 山區的早晨既寒冷又多霧。

examples.en: We have PE class this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們今天下午有體育課。

examples.en: They often enjoy afternoon tea at a cozy café.
examples.zh: 他們經常在溫馨的咖啡館享用下午茶。

examples.en: It usually rains in the afternoon during summer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 台北夏天的下午經常下陣雨。

examples.en: My family watches TV together in the evening.
examples.zh: 我們全家晚上一起看電視。

examples.en: I will finish my English homework this evening.
examples.zh: 我今晚會完成我的英文作業。

examples.en: We took a relaxing walk along the river in the cool evening.
examples.zh: 我們在涼爽的傍晚沿著河邊愜意散步。

examples.en: Don't stay up late at night.
examples.zh: 晚上不要熬夜。

examples.en: The stars look exceptionally bright in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中的星星看起來格外明亮。

examples.en: Good night, have sweet dreams!
examples.zh: 晚安，祝你有個好夢！

examples.en: What day is it today?
examples.zh: 今天是星期幾？

examples.en: Today is my classmate's fourteenth birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是我同班同學的十四歲生日。

examples.en: I have a lot of things to accomplish today.
examples.zh: 我今天有很多事情需要完成。

examples.en: We will have an English quiz tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天有英文小考。

examples.en: Tomorrow will be sunny and warm according to the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 根據天氣預報，明天將是晴朗溫暖的好天氣。

examples.en: See you at the library tomorrow afternoon!
examples.zh: 明天下午圖書館見！

examples.en: I visited my grandparents yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去探望我的祖父母。

examples.en: Did you watch the baseball game on TV yesterday?
examples.zh: 你昨天有看電視上的棒球比賽嗎？

examples.en: Yesterday was the hottest day of this week.
examples.zh: 昨天是這星期最炎熱的一天。

examples.en: What time is it now?
examples.zh: 現在幾點了？

examples.en: We had a great time at the amusement park.
examples.zh: 我們在遊樂園玩得非常開心。

examples.en: Please make sure you arrive on time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會請務必準時抵達。

examples.en: Have a nice day!
examples.zh: 祝你有美好的一天！

examples.en: I practice playing the violin for an hour every day.
examples.zh: 我每天練習拉小提琴一個小時。

examples.en: Sunday is my favorite day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期日是我一週中最喜歡的一天。

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
examples.zh: 一個星期有七天。

examples.en: We are taking final exams next week.
examples.zh: 我們下週要參加期末考。

examples.en: I go to swimming class twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每週上兩次游泳課。

examples.en: We will go on vacation next month.
examples.zh: 我們下個月要去度假。

examples.en: February is usually the shortest month of the year.
examples.zh: 二月通常是一年中最短的月份。

examples.en: She has been learning Spanish for three months.
examples.zh: 她已經學了三個月的西班牙文。

examples.en: Happy New Year to everyone!
examples.zh: 祝大家新年快樂！

examples.en: I will turn sixteen years old this year.
examples.zh: 我今年就要滿十六歲了。

examples.en: Our family travels abroad once a year.
examples.zh: 我們全家每年出國旅遊一次。

examples.en: The movie lasts for two hours.
examples.zh: 這部電影長達兩個小時。

examples.en: It took us an hour to finish the science project.
examples.zh: 我們花了一小時才完成自然科學專題。

examples.en: The train leaves in half an hour.
examples.zh: 火車半小時後發車。

examples.en: Please wait a minute, I will be right back.
examples.zh: 請等一分鐘，我馬上回來。

examples.en: The noodles will be cooked in three minutes.
examples.zh: 麵條煮三分鐘就好了。

examples.en: We still have ten minutes before class begins.
examples.zh: 距離上課我們還有十分鐘時間。

examples.en: The clock on the wall says 3:00 PM.
examples.zh: 牆上的時鐘顯示下午三點。

examples.en: My alarm clock rang loudly at six this morning.
examples.zh: 我的鬧鐘今天早上六點大聲響起。

examples.en: The convenience store is open around the clock.
examples.zh: 那家便利商店全天候二十四小時營業。

examples.en: My dad bought me a digital watch.
examples.zh: 我爸爸買給我一隻數位手錶。

examples.en: Do you want to watch a movie with us tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚想和我們一起看電影嗎？

examples.en: Watch out for cars when you cross the street!
examples.zh: 過馬路時要注意來車！

examples.en: Remember to drink plenty of water every day.
examples.zh: 記得每天多喝水。

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants on the balcony.
examples.zh: 別忘了給陽台上的植物澆水。

examples.en: Can I have a glass of cold water, please?
examples.zh: 請問能給我一杯冰水嗎？

examples.en: Would you like some hot green tea?
examples.zh: 你想來點熱綠茶嗎？

examples.en: Black tea with milk is a classic breakfast drink.
examples.zh: 奶茶是經典的早餐飲品。

examples.en: In Taiwan, tea culture has a very long history.
examples.zh: 在台灣，茶文化有著悠久的歷史。

examples.en: My mother drinks a cup of black coffee every morning.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每天早上喝一杯黑咖啡。

examples.en: The smell of freshly brewed coffee filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 剛煮好的咖啡香氣瀰漫了整個廚房。

examples.en: I prefer iced coffee over hot coffee in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我喜歡喝冰咖啡勝過熱咖啡。

examples.en: Drinking milk is good for your bones.
examples.zh: 喝牛奶對骨骼有益。

examples.en: Put the carton of milk back into the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 請把那盒牛奶放回冰箱裡。

examples.en: She poured some warm milk into her cereal bowl.
examples.zh: 她在麥片碗裡倒了一些溫牛奶。

examples.en: I love fresh orange juice with breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐喜歡配新鮮柳橙汁。

examples.en: Would you like apple juice or grape juice?
examples.zh: 你想要蘋果汁還是葡萄汁？

examples.en: Fresh watermelon juice is very refreshing on hot summer days.
examples.zh: 炎熱的夏天喝新鮮西瓜汁非常消暑解渴。

examples.en: Fried rice is very popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 炒飯在台灣非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Rice is the staple food for most people in Asia.
examples.zh: 米飯是多數亞洲人的主食。

examples.en: Would you like another bowl of steamed rice?
examples.zh: 你想要再來一碗白飯嗎？

examples.en: We bought fresh toast bread from the bakery.
examples.zh: 我們從麵包店買了新鮮吐司麵包。

examples.en: He spread strawberry jam on a slice of bread.
examples.zh: 他在一片麵包上抹了草莓果醬。

examples.en: Whole wheat bread is a healthy choice for breakfast.
examples.zh: 全麥麵包是早餐的健康選擇。

examples.en: Beef noodles are my favorite dish.
examples.zh: 牛肉麵是我最喜歡的料理。

examples.en: He ate a quick bowl of instant noodles for late-night supper.
examples.zh: 他宵夜匆匆吃了一碗泡麵。

examples.en: Traditional handmade noodles have a very chewy texture.
examples.zh: 傳統手工麵條口感非常彈牙有嚼勁。

examples.en: I eat a boiled egg every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃一顆水煮蛋。

examples.en: Crack two eggs into the frying pan to make an omelet.
examples.zh: 在平底鍋打入兩顆蛋來做煎蛋捲。

examples.en: Birds lay eggs in safe nests high up in trees.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在高高的樹上安全築巢產卵。

examples.en: Vegetarians do not eat meat.
examples.zh: 素食者不吃肉類。

examples.en: Keep the raw meat in the freezer until you are ready to cook.
examples.zh: 在準備烹煮之前，請將生肉保存在冷凍庫。

examples.en: Eating too much red meat may not be good for health.
examples.zh: 吃太多紅肉可能對健康無益。

examples.en: Fried chicken cutlet is a famous night market snack.
examples.zh: 炸雞排是著名夜市小吃。

examples.en: Mom is roasting a whole chicken in the oven.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在烤箱裡烤一整隻雞。

examples.en: The farmer feeds the chickens grain every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早上用穀物餵雞。

examples.en: Braised pork rice is a classic Taiwanese dish.
examples.zh: 滷肉飯是經典的台灣料理。

examples.en: Crispy fried pork chops taste great with white rice.
examples.zh: 香酥炸排骨配白飯非常美味。

examples.en: Make sure the pork is thoroughly cooked before serving.
examples.zh: 端上桌前務必確認豬肉已完全煮熟。

examples.en: Do you want beef or chicken for dinner?
examples.zh: 你晚餐想要吃牛肉還是雞肉？

examples.en: Tainan is famous for its fresh beef soup breakfast.
examples.zh: 台南以新鮮牛肉湯早餐聞名。

examples.en: He ordered a medium-rare beef steak at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在餐廳點了一客五分熟的牛排。

examples.en: Fish is rich in healthy oils.
examples.zh: 魚肉富含健康的油脂。

examples.en: My grandfather likes to go fishing by the river on weekends.
examples.zh: 我爺爺週末喜歡去河邊釣魚。

examples.en: We saw colorful tropical fish while snorkeling.
examples.zh: 我們浮潛時看見了五彩繽紛的熱帶魚。

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for delicious fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 台灣以美味的新鮮水果聞名。

examples.en: Eating fresh fruit every day provides essential vitamins.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鮮水果能提供人體必需的維生素。

examples.en: We made a colorful fruit salad with mangoes and apples.
examples.zh: 我們用芒果和蘋果做了一道色彩繽紛的水果沙拉。

examples.en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
examples.zh: 一天一蘋果，醫生遠離我。

examples.en: She cut the red apple into four equal slices.
examples.zh: 她把紅蘋果切成均等的四片。

examples.en: My grandmother baked a warm and fragrant apple pie.
examples.zh: 我奶奶烤了一個溫熱香氣四溢的蘋果派。

examples.en: Monkeys love eating yellow bananas.
examples.zh: 猴子喜歡吃黃色香蕉。

examples.en: I bought a bunch of ripe bananas from the fruit stall.
examples.zh: 我在水果攤買了一串熟成的香蕉。

examples.en: Eating a banana before running gives you quick energy.
examples.zh: 跑步前吃根香蕉能快速補充能量。

examples.en: Let's eat lunch together at noon.
examples.zh: 我們中午一起吃午餐吧。

examples.en: Remember to wash your hands before you eat.
examples.zh: 吃東西前記得要先洗手。

examples.en: We decided to eat out at a nearby noodle shop tonight.
examples.zh: 我們決定今晚到附近的麵店外食。

examples.en: Do not drink cold drinks too fast.
examples.zh: 不要太快喝冷飲。

examples.en: Would you like something warm to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝點溫熱的飲品嗎？

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water after exercising.
examples.zh: 運動後你應該多喝水。

examples.en: I usually eat egg pancakes for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐通常吃蛋餅。

examples.en: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
examples.zh: 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。

examples.en: Dad made us a delicious breakfast with toast and eggs.
examples.zh: 爸爸為我們做了包含吐司和雞蛋的美味早餐。

examples.en: What did you bring for your lunch box?
examples.zh: 你的便當帶了什麼午餐？

examples.en: Students eat lunch in the classroom around noontime.
examples.zh: 學生們大約中午在教室裡吃午餐。

examples.en: Let's go to the cafeteria to have lunch together.
examples.zh: 我們一起去學生餐廳吃午餐吧。

examples.en: We had hot pot for dinner last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚晚餐吃了火鍋。

examples.en: Mom is cooking a wonderful dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在廚房煮一頓豐盛的晚餐。

examples.en: What would you like to have for dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: Taiwanese street food is world famous.
examples.zh: 台灣街頭小吃舉世聞名。

examples.en: Never waste food because many people don't have enough to eat.
examples.zh: 絕不要浪費食物，因為世界上很多人缺乏糧食。

examples.en: Japanese food such as sushi and ramen is very popular here.
examples.zh: 像壽司和拉麵這樣的日本料理在這裡很受歡迎。

examples.en: This restaurant serves delicious seafood.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應美味的海鮮。

examples.en: We celebrated Dad's birthday at a fancy Italian restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在一家高級義大利餐廳慶祝爸爸的生日。

examples.en: The restaurant is always crowded during weekend dinner hours.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳在週末晚餐時段總是高朋滿座。

examples.en: Mom goes to the supermarket every weekend.
examples.zh: 媽媽每個週末都去超市。

examples.en: There is a large supermarket across from our apartment.
examples.zh: 我們公寓對面有一間大型超市。

examples.en: We bought fresh milk, bread, and fruits at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我們在超市買了鮮奶、麵包和水果。

examples.en: I want to buy a new pencil case.
examples.zh: 我想買一個新的鉛筆盒。

examples.en: Where did you buy those cool white sneakers?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那雙酷炫的白色球鞋？

examples.en: Many people prefer to buy daily necessities online.
examples.zh: 許多人偏好在網路上購買生活必需品。

examples.en: Convenience stores in Taiwan sell almost everything.
examples.zh: 台灣的便利商店幾乎什麼都賣。

examples.en: That bakery sells out of egg tarts very quickly every morning.
examples.zh: 那家麵包店每天早上蛋塔很快就賣光了。

examples.en: The bookstore sells stationery and art supplies as well.
examples.zh: 那家書店也販售文具和美術用品。

examples.en: How much money do you need for the trip?
examples.zh: 這次旅行你需要多少錢？

examples.en: It is important to learn how to save money from a young age.
examples.zh: 從小學習如何存錢非常重要。

examples.en: He spent all his pocket money on new video games.
examples.zh: 他把所有零用錢都花在買新電玩遊戲上了。

examples.en: The price of this t-shirt is very reasonable.
examples.zh: 這件 T 恤的價格很合理。

examples.en: House prices in big cities have increased significantly.
examples.zh: 大城市的房價已經顯著上漲。

examples.en: Always check the price tag before making a purchase.
examples.zh: 購買前務必先看一下價格標籤。

examples.en: You can pay with an EasyCard here.
examples.zh: 你可以在這裡用悠遊卡付款。

examples.en: How much did you pay for that concert ticket?
examples.zh: 你那張演唱會門票花了多少錢？

examples.en: Hard work will always pay off in the end.
examples.zh: 辛勤的付出最終總會有回報的。
